reportDescription.message: Describe what went wrong. The report goes straight to the maintainers.

reportPlaceholder.message: What happened? Which provider is affected?

reportPrivacy.message: Sends your message with the extension version, language, and which provider cards are enabled.

welcomeSubtitle.message: Keep your limits one click away — the popup opens straight from the browser toolbar.

welcomeStepPin.message: Click the extensions icon {icon} in the toolbar, then pin AI Usage Tracker

welcomeStepOpen.message: Click the pinned icon to see your usage

welcomeCtaHint.message: You can unpin it later from Chrome.

optionsLanguageDescription.message: Choose the language for the popup, this page, and the on-page overlays.

optionsLanguageHint.message: Switching the language reloads this page.

optionsLayoutDescription.message: Choose how visible provider cards are arranged in the popup.

optionsLayoutSingleDescription.message: A full-width card for each provider.

optionsLayoutGridDescription.message: A compact overview with two cards per row.

optionsProvidersDescription.message: Hide a card or choose the usage details it can display. Unavailable data stays hidden automatically.

optionsGlmKeyHint.message: Optional. Use it when this browser is not signed in to z.ai, or for BigModel accounts.

optionsBadgeDescription.message: The extension icon changes by 10% ranges based on this source.

optionsBadgeHighestDescription.message: Use the largest current percentage among shown provider cards.

optionsBadgeSelectedDescription.message: Use one provider regardless of the popup visibility of other cards.

optionsBadgeHiddenWarning.message: This provider is hidden in the popup, but its badge range stays active.

optionsOverlaysDescription.message: Show the collapsible usage capsule next to the message composer.

optionsResetDescription.message: Restores every preference on this page. This cannot be undone.
